command:
set -u
echo "== go search"; ls /usr/local/go/bin/go /root/go /usr/lib/go*/bin/go 2>&1 | head -5; find / -xdev -name go -type f -perm -u+x -not -path "*/proc/*" 2>/dev/null | head -5
echo "== start long job (tmux, nice19, ionice idle, timeout 660s)"
J=/workspace/jobs/hb-test-20261001; mkdir -p $J
cat > $J/run.sh <<'RUN'
#!/bin/bash
J=/workspace/jobs/hb-test-20261001
echo $$ > $J/pid; date -u +%FT%TZ > $J/started
i=0
while [ $i -lt 20 ]; do i=$((i+1)); echo "$(date -u +%FT%TZ) beat=$i load=$(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/loadavg)" >> $J/heartbeat.log; sleep 30; done
echo done > $J/DONE
RUN
chmod +x $J/run.sh
tmux kill-session -t job-hb-test 2>/dev/null || true
tmux new-session -d -s job-hb-test "nice -n 19 ionice -c3 timeout 660 $J/run.sh; echo \$? > $J/exit_code; date -u +%FT%TZ > $J/ended"
sleep 2; tmux ls; cat $J/pid; cat $J/heartbeat.log
echo "== pids/zombies before"; ps -eo stat= | grep -c '^Z'; echo "== nice of job"; ps -o pid,ni,args -p $(cat $J/pid)
